title: Forever Line
description: This project is for foods, It adds ramen, chicken and noodles and a lot more! Have fun cooking or open a restaurant.
body:
### Summary
  This mod is a cooking mod that allows you to make new foods or open a resturant in multiplayer! It adds ramen chicken and noodle soup and a lot more. If you want to just cook you can wanna just use your extra sugar cane you can do that! Have fun and make this mod count!

### Why You Should Download
- Fun
- Cooking
- First Food Mod I Made
### Quote
> Ace Pax N' Mods
A project is never complete until you say it is
